question: __________ (NRLM) is a poverty alleviation project implemented by the Government of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __National Rural Livelihood Mission__.

__
 
• NRLM is a poverty alleviation project.
 
• It aims at promoting self-employment among the rural poor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

__
 
• NRLM was launched in 2011.
 
• NRLM is being implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development.
 
• Swarnajayanti Grameen Swarojgar Yojna was remodeled and restructured to form NRLM.
 
• It focuses on the development of Self Help Groups (SHG).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihood Mission was launched in 2014.

 
 
• It is being implemented by the Ministry of Urban and Housing Affairs.
 
• It was launched in 2014.
 
• It is a centrally sponsored scheme.
